# GuGu

> Vietnamese beauty & wellness booking marketplace. One universal Expo app (iOS, Android, web) plus a NestJS + PostgreSQL API in a TypeScript monorepo, hosted on AWS Singapore. AI-first: every domain has a subagent, a skill and agent-friendly docs.

Start with AGENTS.md. Customers pay at the salon (no payment processing). Booking needs no OTP (X11): name + phone, abuse limited by rate limits and history. Vietnamese is the default locale; English is second. There is no git remote yet: agents work in per-task worktrees and the orchestrator merges locally after gates and reviewer agents.

## Core
- [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md): entry point, non-negotiables, where things are
- [AI-first conventions](ai-first-conventions.md): subagent/skill/doc formats and per-domain deliverables
- [Glossary](glossary.md): vi/en domain terms used in code and UI
- [Local git workflow](../.claude/skills/architecture/references/git-workflow.md): worktrees, commit convention, merge gate, reviewers
- [Ownership map](../.claude/skills/architecture/references/ownership.md): which agent owns which path; hot files

## Plan
- [00 Roadmap](tasks/00-roadmap.md): build order, cross-topic resolutions X1–X8, gates
- [GuGu Roadmap — live tracker](https://claude.ai/artifact/CkweFTJGUNC1M9hoCAmwn3): source of truth for task status and product questions (read/write via ArtifactData)
- [Open questions](tasks/open-questions.md): historical snapshot; live questions are in the tracker
- [Tracker inbox](tasks/tracker-inbox.jsonl): fallback queue of tracker writes, synced by the orchestrator

## Task specs
- [01 Architecture](tasks/01-architecture.md): monorepo, toolchain baseline, boundaries, API conventions, AI-first + git workflow
- [02 Design system](tasks/02-design-system.md): tokens, expressive/calm modes, motion, 3D hero
- [03 Localization](tasks/03-localization.md): vi/en resources, formatting, coverage tests
- [04 Backend & database](tasks/04-backend-database.md): Prisma schema, PostGIS, outbox, media
- [05 Auth & security](tasks/05-auth-security.md): OTP, sessions, RBAC, tenant isolation, privacy
- [06 Booking engine](tasks/06-booking-engine.md): availability, holds, concurrency, state machine
- [07 Salon CRM](tasks/07-salon-crm.md): salon workspace, calendar, CRM, insights, metric registry
- [08 AI agent](tasks/08-ai-agent.md): in-product assistant, tool registry, evals, quotas
- [09 Zalo](tasks/09-zalo.md): Zalo OA, Template Messages, inbox, login, Mini App
- [10 Marketplace & SEO](tasks/10-marketplace-seo.md): homepage, search, salon pages, SEO rendering
- [11 Customer & notifications](tasks/11-customer-notifications.md): accounts, reviews, notification platform
- [12 Monetization & admin](tasks/12-monetization-admin.md): attribution, commissions, plans, analytics, admin
- [13 Platform & DevOps](tasks/13-platform-devops.md): Docker, CI, EAS, deep links, testing, observability

## Agents
- [orchestrator](../.claude/agents/orchestrator.md): routes multi-domain work, manages worktrees, runs reviewers, merges locally, reports
- [architecture](../.claude/agents/architecture.md): monorepo, contracts pipeline, ADRs, lockfile, architecture review
- Domain agents: [design-system](../.claude/agents/design-system.md), [localization](../.claude/agents/localization.md), [backend-database](../.claude/agents/backend-database.md), [auth-security](../.claude/agents/auth-security.md), [booking-engine](../.claude/agents/booking-engine.md), [salon-crm](../.claude/agents/salon-crm.md), [ai-agent](../.claude/agents/ai-agent.md), [zalo](../.claude/agents/zalo.md), [marketplace-seo](../.claude/agents/marketplace-seo.md), [customer-notifications](../.claude/agents/customer-notifications.md), [monetization-admin](../.claude/agents/monetization-admin.md), [platform-devops](../.claude/agents/platform-devops.md), [test-engineer](../.claude/agents/test-engineer.md)
- Reviewers: [security-reviewer](../.claude/agents/security-reviewer.md), [design-reviewer](../.claude/agents/design-reviewer.md); localization, test-engineer, ai-agent and architecture also run in review mode
